deviations: Confirmation-page screenshot was captured and visually verified by the browser task, but its artifact path was not returned in the handoff, so the confirmation screenshot file itself is unavailable in this bundle. The exact confirmation code is preserved verbatim from the task's textual observation (evidence/confirmation-note.md). Empty-form and filled-form screenshots are preserved.

Two benign stale AX-reference retries occurred inside the browser task (one on field fill, one on submit click); each succeeded on the immediate retry with a fresh ref scope. Both are counted inside the single attempt; the form was submitted exactly once.
The first browser.spawn_task call in this run failed on a tool-schema refresh before any browser action started; it was retried once with the current schema. No duplicate browser attempt was created.

Operator supplemented the missing confirmation screenshot with an independently captured completed-browser preview. Agent-prepared platform/operator evidence labels corrected to agent_export. Unrelated parked-task details generalized for privacy.

isolation_notes: New individual run_id muse-browser-form-20261002-01; the older paces-everyday pilot results were not reused and no other benchmark tasks were started.
Shared managed browser profile with unrelated parked tasks. Profile reset was not verified; unrelated state was preserved. Unrelated task details omitted from this public copy.
Existing side-chat context was present; fixture interaction was limited to the benchmark form at the configured fixture_base_url.
Unrelated carts, scheduled jobs, accounts, and memories were preserved. No purchase was made and no unrelated conversations were used.

tasks.disclosure_note: Tool-call accounting (measurable): the browser task itself executed 8 native steps (7 browser_automation actions + 1 handoff), inside the 50-call budget. Orchestration around it (bundle download + SHA-256 verification, reading the task sheet/inputs/template, spawning and inspecting the browser task, verifying both screenshots visually, writing this report, validating and packaging) used 20 additional tool calls, for a run total of 28 — also inside the budget. Active duration covers the browser task's created_at to updated_at (49 s); bundle download/verification, evidence review, and report writing are excluded from active time per the report contract. input_tokens/output_tokens are not observable from this harness and are left null. The confirmation code above is the exact text observed on the confirmation page; it was not guessed. No HTTP submission and no fixture source/log inspection were used.
